description: This file defines a protocol `NoteRepository` that specifies asynchronous methods for creating, updating, deleting, fetching, and syncing notes in a local persistence layer, likely used in an iOS note-taking app.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note and persists it locally.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note locally; marks it dirty for future sync.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Soft-deletes a note (tombstone) locally; marks it dirty for future sync.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Loads notes matching an optional query (title/content contains, case/diacritic insensitive).

methods.name: fetchDirtyNotes
methods.description: Loads notes that need syncing (dirty/failed or never synced).

methods.name: markNotesSyncing
methods.description: Marks notes as 'syncing' prior to push so UI/business logic can differentiate in-flight vs dirty/failed.

methods.name: markNotesClean
methods.description: Marks notes as 'clean' after a successful push and sets `lastSyncedAt` to the provided timestamp.

methods.name: markNotesFailed
methods.description: Marks notes as 'failed' after a push attempt fails, so they remain eligible for retry.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Applies remote notes into the local store using last-write-wins by `updatedAt`.
